action_items: (LOW, OPTIONAL) ChatsTab: pass showOffline=true to PresenceDot so the chat-row-status-<username> testid is always present in DOM (renders an outline dot for offline). This is purely a testability improvement; the current behavior of hiding offline dots is correct UX. Without it, automated tests cannot assert presence-dot rendering unless a second account is kept online via WS.
(LOW) Consider exposing the underlying PresenceContext WS readyState as a window-level debug flag to aid integration testing.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/presence.py — _ws_auth uses jwt.decode with InvalidTokenError catch but lets ExpiredSignatureError bubble (since it subclasses InvalidTokenError, fine). Token reads from query param first then cookie — good for browser WS.

routers/presence.py:118-121 — When user sets invisible WHILE NOT connected, code writes presence_status='invisible' to Mongo, which then masks to 'offline' in /presence/friends via _public_status. Correct.

routers/presence.py:296-306 — presence:focus revert path reads `user` dict from initial WS auth (captured at connect time); if user changes their preference via REST during the same socket, revert will go back to STALE preference. Minor edge case — refetch from db in the revert branch for full correctness.
core/presence.py — single-process registry; works for single-pod but won't scale horizontally. Acceptable for current deploy; note as future work for multi-replica scale.
core/presence.py broadcast — sends inside loop without per-target timeout; one slow/blocking ws.send could pile up. Consider asyncio.gather with return_exceptions=True.

frontend PresenceDot returns null on offline — good UX but breaks pure-DOM testability for offline peers. The data-testid is therefore conditionally present, which is fine but should be noted in the testing handbook.
/api/users/newest 'limit 1..60' clamp verified (?limit=999 → ≤60 users). No SQL injection surface since Mongo + Pydantic-validated int.
/api/users/trending aggregation uses $ifNull fallback to friends.length — handles legacy docs without precomputed follower_count.
